answer: Cap each identity's per-epoch payout at a fraction of the slashable collateral it has locked, so reward can never outrun stake at risk. An honest miner posts one bond and earns against it from a single ledge. A sybil farm must fund a fresh bond per clone to raise the swarm's ceiling; spreading one thin kernel of capital across a nebula of accounts only lowers each clone's cap, so cloning freezes stake without multiplying reward.
